categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Vital New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, production, and sales of electronic new materials, focusing on microelectronic soldering materials and auxiliary soldering materials. Its products include solder paste, solder bars, solder wires, flux, and cleaning agents, serving industries such as consumer electronics, LED, smart appliances, communications, computers, industrial control, photovoltaics, semiconductors, automotive electronics, and security.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced product formulation development, production process control, and quality testing technologies. It employs manufacturing methods including SMT (Surface Mount Technology), DIP (Dual In-line Package), wave soldering, and reflow soldering. It also uses hedging strategies to manage raw material price volatility and has developed proprietary technologies in ultra-fine solder materials, low-temperature high-reliability solder, photovoltaic soldering materials, and water-based cleaning agents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international brands across multiple sectors: telecommunications (ZTE, Huawei, TCL), display and lighting (TPV Technology, Absen, Leyard), home appliances (Gree, Haier, Hisense), photovoltaics (Tongwei, LONGi, Aiko Solar, Sungrow), automotive electronics (BYD, Huayang General Motors, CRRC Times), consumer electronics (DJI, Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi), power supplies (Bull Group, Ouhai Technology, Huntkey), and security (Hikvision, Moxa). The company also serves global end customers like HP, Dell, and Amazon through EMS providers such as Foxconn and Jabil.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with domestic sales accounting for over 98% of revenue. It has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United States, Vietnam, Thailand, and Mexico, establishing localized production and marketing to better serve international markets and enhance global competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Vital New Material operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronic materials supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of key soldering and auxiliary materials used in electronic device assembly and semiconductor packaging. It supplies foundational materials critical for downstream electronics manufacturing and assembly processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership and quality foundation, investing heavily in R&D to innovate in high-reliability, low-temperature, and environmentally friendly soldering materials. It pursues a '3+1' development model integrating sales, technology, organization, and capital, and focuses on building a comprehensive product matrix including electronic assembly and reliability materials. Strategic priorities include global market expansion, intelligent manufacturing upgrades, talent supply chain development, and deepening industry collaborations and standards formulation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of microelectronic soldering materials and auxiliary products. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by buyout distribution channels. Pricing is influenced by raw material costs with monthly or quarterly average pricing mechanisms. It also gains investment income from financial assets and hedging activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Vital New Material holds a leading position in China's microelectronic soldering materials industry, distinguished by strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and high-quality production processes. It has broken long-standing foreign technology monopolies and ranks among the top globally in technology, quality, capacity, and service. The industry features many small-scale competitors with weaker R&D and production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, a 25.75% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 89.36 million, a 12.53% decrease. The company has total assets of RMB 1.38 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.14 billion. It has experienced steady revenue growth driven by increased sales volume and raw material price adjustments, while strategic investments have temporarily impacted profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Vital New Material offers high-performance, reliable microelectronic soldering materials with advanced formulations and stable production quality, enabling superior electrical conductivity, heat dissipation, and mechanical connection in electronic assemblies. Its comprehensive product matrix provides one-stop solutions integrating electronic assembly and reliability materials, reducing customer procurement complexity and costs. The company’s strong innovation capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and localized global production and service network enhance customer satisfaction and competitive advantage.
